description: ADULT critical-care regimens and forms from a user-supplied extract of the ICU Quick Drug Guide 2025 (items 101–150). Every regimen is labelled 'Adult (ICU guide)' and every form line '[ICU guide 2025]'; none is a paediatric dose. All notes are unverified; 'CHECK' lines mark entries that look inconsistent. Importing merges into existing notes of the same drug name, adding only new rows.
